Headline: Blue Line Experiencing Delays; Boarding change between California and Damen
ShortDescription: Blue Line service running w/delays due to track conditions near California; board all trains on the O'Hare-bound side at California, Western and Damen.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Blue Line service is running with delays due to track conditions near California.

Trains, in both directions, are running on the same track between California and Damen.

Board/exit all trains on the O'Hare- bound side of the platform at California, Western, and Damen.

Shuttle buses are available from California to Damen to provide connecting service through the affected area.

We're working to restore normal service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
